## Recognise a difference of two squares

Look for two square terms separated by subtraction. Use $a^2-b^2=(a-b)(a+b)$.

:::::: {.example-pair}

::::: {.model}

<h3>Worked example</h3>

$9x^2-25$

::: {.fragment}

[Write each term as a square.]{.annotation}

$=(3x)^2-5^2$

:::

::: {.fragment}

[Use the same two terms in both brackets.]{.annotation}

$=(3x-5)(3x+5)$

:::

:::::

::::: {.paper}

::: {.fragment}

<h3>Your turn</h3>

$9x^2-49$

Which number changes in the brackets? Factorise on paper.

:::

::: {.fragment}

[Check your working]{.annotation}

$=(3x)^2-7^2$

$=(3x-7)(3x+7)$

:::
